name: What happens to the old siding after it's been stripped off my house?

mainEntity.name: What happens to the old siding after it's been stripped off my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: After your old siding is stripped off, it is carefully collected and prepared for disposal. The specific disposal method depends on the type of material. Wood siding might be recycled or taken to a landfill, while vinyl siding can often be recycled at specialized facilities. Our team at City Dweller, LLC prioritizes environmentally responsible disposal practices whenever possible. We ensure that all debris is removed from your property promptly and legally, leaving the site clean and ready for the next phase of your siding project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Old siding is collected and disposed of, with recycling prioritized for eligible materials. Our team ensures prompt, legal, and environmentally responsible debris removal from your property.
